name: Convenience Girl
original_name: コンビニエンスガール
source:
The girl working at the convenience store is very convenient indeed.
This is a hard erotic adventure game that takes place in a convenience store.
Otobane Kotoko will do anything the protagonist asks of her.
She is a freelance employee at the convenience store.
What are the various fates that await her?
